prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: game VFX animation SPRITE SHEET with real transparent alpha, preview only.
Input image 1 is a contact sheet of eight moments of ONE reference green wind tornado. Use it only to understand wind material, silhouette, angle and swirling motion. Recreate an original effect matching that visual direction, do NOT copy the dark checker grid, floor, editor, text, or camera.
Deliver ONE large square RGBA image, preferably 2048x2048, containing EXACTLY SIXTEEN coherent consecutive animation frames in a perfectly regular 4 columns by 4 rows grid with no visible borders, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom.

SUBJECT in each cell: one emerald/mint green magical tornado, small at the ground and wider above, with a 3D hollow wind funnel, irregular overlapping translucent wind sheets and wisps, thin fast white-mint cutting streaks, subtle green glow, dust curling at its base and a few tiny ochre leaves and grey stones. Reference has broad luminous wind sweeps interspersed with open clear air, convincing near/far dimness, smooth curled tips, a grounded dust footprint. Keep that light airy energetic green wind, not a heavy white cloud sculpture, not a painted green cone, not a regular spring. Premium stylized fantasy tower defence spell, hand-crafted ARPG VFX quality; camera slightly elevated frontal orthographic, sees the oval top opening and ground footprint.

ANIMATION CRITICAL: these are 16 consecutive time samples of the SAME stationary looping tornado, NOT sixteen alternatives or different cameras. Phase 0,22.5,45,67.5 degrees etc to337.5degrees of one full clockwise revolution. Frame 15 continues naturally into frame0. Surface wind streaks and a couple of readable leaves progress smoothly around the vertical axis and upward. Maintain identical overall height, width, centerline, footprint, exposure, colors, camera, lighting and density in every cell. Small changing internal surface folds only. Do not grow or shrink between frames. The green form should remain stable when frames are played in order, instead of sixteen unrelated tornado drawings.

EXACT LAYOUT: each cell is 512x512 if output2048. One tornado per cell. Identical ground anchor local x256 y442 in every cell; overall visible bounds approximately x72..440 and y55..454. Keep at least40px truly transparent empty padding on every cell edge, no cell-to-cell bleed. Each effect is centered on its own identical vertical axis. No contact shadows on a floor; only actual isolated semi-transparent dust belongs to the effect.
COLOR: emerald green, jade, mint, narrow pale mint highlights, grey-beige base dust. The middle is translucent with genuinely empty gaps. Bright strokes have tapered wind-torn tips and internal depth, not flat satin strips.
BACKGROUND: genuine transparent RGBA, alpha zero in empty areas, natural semi-transparent wind glow and dust. No solid black background, no fake transparency grid. No labels, frame numbers, watermark, decorative borders, other objects or characters.
Preserve consistency across the sixteen frames above adding ornamental complexity.

Edit the provided generated 4x4 green tornado animation sprite sheet. Keep its original emerald/mint luminous wind visual style, 3D translucent folds, base dust, tiny autumn leaves and stones. This is a GAME FLIPBOOK, not a poster.
Critical fix: all sixteen effects are much too large and bleed into neighbouring cells. Rebuild the sheet in EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and FOUR equal rows on a square true-transparent RGBA canvas. Each tornado must be about 65% of its cell width and 68% of its cell height, leaving at least16% completely empty transparent space on EVERY side, including below dust and above all glow. On a1254px square each cell is about313px: each tornado including glow fits inside local x55..258 y50..265 with ground anchor at local x156 y260. Larger output2048 preferred but 4x4 exact equal geometry matters most. NOTHING from any effect may cross its own cell boundary. No horizontal ghost stripes from neighbouring dust, no clipped glow at edges. Transparent gutters separate all16 frames.

Fix temporal coherence at same time: the SAME tornado in sixteen consecutive phases of ONE clockwise revolution at22.5degrees per frame. Left to right top to bottom, from0 through337.5degrees. Each phase advances the visible wind streaks and leaves a SMALL distance from its predecessor. Do not repeat the first row three more times. Last337.5phase leads naturally back to0phase. Same size/camera/axis/ground anchor/brightness in every frame. No per-frame zooms or position change. Only surface winds swirl clockwise and rise; dust rolls around the stationary bottom.
Airy emerald/jade/mint wind with bright narrow white-mint curled streaks, no opaque green cap or flat green upper bowl, no heavy cotton white cloud. Dust stays grey beige. Make upper wind more wispy and less uniformly thick. No added scene, no grid, no typography, no watermark or frame numbers. Genuine semi-transparent alpha wind and dust, alpha zero in ALL gutters, not a checkerboard background.

Create a NEW professional 2D game VFX sprite flipbook atlas.
Image1 is a single reference moment for the desired GREEN MAGICAL WIND TORNADO; use material and angle only, omit all background. Match the reference's emerald translucent wind, white-mint cutting swirls, small ochre leaves, grey beige dust. Avoid cotton clouds or a green opaque upper bowl.
Output one square transparent PNG containing exactly16 animation frames in4columns4rows. Each frame is a VERY SMALL centered isolated tornado surrounded by LOTS OF EMPTY SPACE. Every tornado including all glow occupies ONLY THE CENTRAL HALF of its cell width and central60%of cell height. Large CLEAR alpha-zero gutters, at least20%of each cell on left/right and15%above/below. This generous empty space is the MOST IMPORTANT requirement. Do NOT zoom in or fill the cells. No part of an effect near a cell boundary.
Same upright tornado in all16 cells, same size and perspective, dark emerald rear wind folds and mint front curves. Tapered grounded toe, wider open wind crown, wispy swept flow, semi-transparent gaps. Grey tan dust rolls around bottom. Bright pale mint strokes are irregular broken wind sheets with tapered ends, not literal satin ribbons. Slightly elevated front orthographic camera, static framing.
These are consecutive TIME FRAMES of one looping rotation. Each frame advances22.5degrees clockwise; total360degrees. Surface patterns and leaves advance gradually, do NOT repeat the same4poses on each row. Cell1matches cell16plus one step, seamless cycle requested. Ground anchor and silhouette stay fixed.
Empty background is REAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA, including the large gutters. No floor, no editor checker, no scene, no borders, no cell numbers, no text, no watermarks. The one supplied reference is style only, not a frame to clone. Generate a new coherent16-frame sequence.
